interface.title: VNC-Quant / VNC-Dist (Colavita & Perkins Lab)
interface.field: C. elegans neurodevelopment: positioning of ventral nerve cord motoneurons
interface.stage_of_work: analysis and visualisation of measurements already taken (relative antero-posterior neuron positions), plus significance testing between genotypes
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn worm-outline images and neuron coordinates into normalised positions along the body, then compare those positions between wild-type and mutant worms with arrow, violin-box, ranked-order and QQ/Shapiro-Wilk views.

data.note: WT_control_RD.csv and sax-3_mutant_RD.csv, which already hold relative distances, were uploaded in the Arrow, Violin-Box, Ranked position and QQ-Shapiro tabs. There were no PNG worm outlines, so the sidebar Process step (relative distances) could not run. Several views crashed: in this deployment the installed matplotlib is not compatible with the app's code (boxplot labels= and cm.get_cmap).

features.name: Control-vs-mutant displacement arrow plot with significance markers
features.general: Load a control dataset and one or more treatment datasets, label each one, and draw one band per group. Each item's mean position is a marker, an arrow runs from the control mean to the treatment mean, and stars mark significant shifts. Hover to read values; box-zoom, reset and save the chart as an image.
features.specific: Arrow tab: upload the Ctrl CSV and set Ctrl Annotation, upload one or more Mutant CSVs and annotate each, press Run. The plot has one horizontal band per group; DA/SAB are green, DB orange, DD red. Arrows show displacement from the WT mean and ** marks significant neurons (DD4, DA3 for sax-3). The genotype names for the bands and the x-axis title (% of distance from SABVL to the rectum) do not appear on screen; only tick numbers 10–100 show, so bands cannot be told apart on the chart. Per-neuron t-tests with Cohen's d are calculated but never shown. Plotly toolbar: box zoom (changes only the x range), reset axes, PNG download; pan was not tried.
steps: upload control CSV and set its label
upload one or more mutant CSVs and label each
hover or box-zoom to inspect a neuron's shift
download the plot as a PNG
serves_tasks: Show how far each mutant cell's mean position moved from the control mean, with significance marks
Add a second comparison group to the same chart

features.name: Per-individual rank-order grid
features.general: For each individual in a dataset, rank its items by position and draw one coloured row per individual, so individuals whose order differs from the rest stand out.
features.specific: Ranked position tab: upload one or more RD CSVs, give each a title, press Run. You get one grid per file: each row is a worm, and its cells are the neurons in antero-posterior order, coloured by class (green/magenta/grey). Expand to fullscreen to inspect. A file that cannot be processed (e.g. NA values: 'Cannot convert non-finite values (NA or inf) to integer') gives its own error and does not block the others.
serves_tasks: Find individual animals whose cells are out of the expected order

features.name: Multi-file upload with a label per file
features.general: Upload several data files at once. The interface creates a label field for each file, and those labels name the groups in the analysis that runs next. Files can be removed or added before running.
features.specific: In the Arrow, Violin-Box, Ranked position and QQ-Shapiro tabs the uploader lists each CSV with an x to remove it and a + to add more, and shows an 'Annotation for <file>' / 'Title for <file>' / 'Genotype for <file>' box per file before the Run/Generate button. Bug: label boxes follow a file's position in the list, not its name, so after removing a file the remaining file inherits the removed file's label (sax-3 showed 'WT'). Checked in the Arrow and Ranked position tabs only.

type a label for each file, re-checking labels after any removal
